name: mmse_resampler_cc_fast
description: fractional resampler, input step 0.9983000159263611 (a float32 value, like GNU Radio) per output, vs mmse_resampler_cc

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: Same polyphase structure and phase quantisation (1/128); the taps are a least squares design that agrees with GNU Radio's table to 1.2e-5, worst case 8 * 1.2e-5 * 0.66 = 2 LSB, measured 0.03 LSB. The input step is a float32 value so both accumulate the same phase.

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Eight taps rounded to Q15 (8 * 0.5 * 0.66 = 2.6 LSB worst case) plus output rounding. Measured 1.7 LSB.
